interpolation.elevation: shape-preserving PCHIP separately at every nonzero anchor; low anchors use even 20..80 evidence, TAU025 anchors use 25,35,..,80 evidence
interpolation.opacity: piecewise linear in LOS optical depth through ordered anchors

limitations: representation contract only; no observational calibration validation
value continuity at .15 is guaranteed by the shared operator anchor; derivative continuity is not a gate

owner_accepted_tau015_comparison.method: coordinator fixed-DJF25 TolTECA-v1 band/alpha/elevation comparison; accepted as negligible

reference_profile.meaning: declared model approximation; not inferred atmospheric truth

engineering_availability_regime.interpolation_fidelity: TAU025 profile-conditioned held-out study: fixed-DJF25 is included; aggregate all-profile piecewise-linear maximum is 0.532005%, not a science-quality or observational result.
engineering_availability_regime.observational_accuracy: not evaluated; engineering availability is not calibrated-science validation.

science_qualification_regime.interpolation_fidelity: The inherited low-opacity fixed-DJF25 study is numerical representation evidence only; its manifest records primary_holdout_fidelity_pass=false, so this contract does not claim a passing science numerical-fidelity gate.
science_qualification_regime.observational_accuracy: not evaluated; no absolute-flux or repeatability claim.

spectral_reference.alpha_interpolation_or_extrapolation: prohibited without a separately validated contract
spectral_reference.map_meaning_limitation: reference-spectrum convention only; it does not assert every source in a map has that spectrum
spectral_reference.quicklook: pointing and OOF quicklook may omit the field and use the default
spectral_reference.selection: select one already precomputed alpha surface once per reduction; never integrate per sample
spectral_reference.semantics: reference source spectrum S_nu proportional to nu^alpha for calibrated map/product meaning
